svg.aria-label: Worked rectangle six metres wide and eight metres high, opposing corners linked by a diagonal and by two edges. Stages separately recall hypotenuse relation and a distinct boundary route; no primary practice result is shown.
svg.title: Staged right triangle and route types
svg.desc: Original worked case. Given perpendicular sides six and eight metres; stages display givens, then the known distance relation, then two route types for later comparison.
